wordFamily: Not working
note: notWorking from status; red ring with inner dot

wordFamily: Offline
note: Shipped thing-specific wording for notWorking; do not turn it into a quiet grey state.

wordFamily: Needs a look
note: needsLook from status; amber dot. It never means “the person must answer”.

wordFamily: Learning
note: learning; hollow muted ring (web 8px; native 10pt).

wordFamily: Connected
note: connected; no standalone mark. A level pill retains its shipped small green dot.

wordFamily: Running (healthy server)
note: Shipped connected alias on server cards, from fleet status.

wordFamily: Disk array failed · Running warm · Running hot · {server statusNote}
note: Use the status flag for the level; this is the thing’s supplied reason, not a fifth level.

wordFamily: Waiting for you
scale: Thread stage, when waiting is true
note: Wins over working, handed-over and settled flags. Elsewhere (automation/step/sign-in) it is a local workflow detail.

wordFamily: {assistant} is working
note: A flag-driven label in this review’s common scale. Shipped work rows use the more specific phrases below.

wordFamily: is thinking · is working · {progress}% · is answering T3 Code
note: Only live run/typing metadata supplies this; never infer work from the prose of a reply.

wordFamily: {assistant} is looking into it · {assistant} is on it · I’m on it.
note: Research state looking/fixing supplies work. A historic sentence alone supplies no current state.

wordFamily: Handed over
note: Active handoff metadata; lower precedence than waiting or assistant work. Current UI often names T3 Code instead of a generic badge.

wordFamily: Settled · Settled by itself … · Settled when …
note: Only settled state. Keep Settle and its Undo. Inbox Settled is a group, not thing health.

wordFamily: New reply
note: Unread flag only. Can accompany a stage and never changes thing health.

wordFamily: Needs you · N things need you
note: Reserved for the Inbox. The count measures only the person’s group, not heads-ups or assistant work.

wordFamily: {assistant}’s on it
note: Who acts next, not a health level. Individual rows can derive an assistant-working stage.

wordFamily: Heads-ups · Show N heads-ups · Hide heads-ups
note: Never count or colour a health mark from fyi. Starts folded in Inbox / ordinary notices panels.

wordFamily: Later · Ignored · Snoozed · Reminded later
note: A quieting state; no health escalation and no thread failed flag.

wordFamily: Worth a look
note: Not a synonym for Needs a look. Can contain problem, person-only and information rows.

wordFamily: Problem: · Needs a look: · Only you · SOON
note: Nature and grouping inside a panel. SOON currently exposes heads-ups in the service strip (UIR-70). The shared round’s folded rule needs a keeps-decision version beside any variant that reopens UIR-70.

wordFamily: NEEDS A PERSON · {assistant} needs your OK · {ASSISTANT} IS ASKING
note: A pending card supplies waiting only through its pending/viewer flags. The code-approval eyebrow remains contextual.

wordFamily: APPROVED · WAITING FOR CHECKS · READY TO DEPLOY · DEPLOYED · DECLINED
note: Card-level conditions/outcomes; never manufacture thread health. Red for Declined is a loudness mismatch to review, not a new thread flag.

wordFamily: Scheduled for tonight, {time} · Running · Done · It didn’t work · You said no
note: Execution/decision state from approvalAnswer. A scheduled yes is not still waiting for the person.

wordFamily: Approved by {person} · Declined by {person}
note: History, not current thread stage.

wordFamily: Asked {assistant} · Asked a question
note: May be addressed to the assistant, not the person. Read question recipient/flags before choosing a stage.

wordFamily: Asked {assistant} to undo this · Asked {assistant} to try again.
note: Confirms a request, not completion. Do not read it as success.

wordFamily: Asked {time} · Asked by {person} in {place}
note: Not a state.

wordFamily: Not handed over yet · Not handed over
note: No active handoff yet.

wordFamily: Waiting its turn · Working · After N · Waits for N, which didn’t finish
note: When a handoff is active its thread stage is Handed over; these are task details.

wordFamily: Needs your OK in T3 Code
note: Only an outstanding person-directed approval supplies Waiting for you.

wordFamily: Waiting for checks · Checks failing
note: Checks are running/failing inside the handoff. Do not invent a failed thread flag or a person decision.

wordFamily: Waiting to merge · Merging · Merged · Not merged
note: Follow the recorded merge state, not a task’s “done” wording.

wordFamily: Done · Stopped · Ran into a problem · Ran out of time · N didn’t finish
note: An outcome can explain an unresolved thread; it is never a fifth stage named failed.

wordFamily: On · Off · Not on yet · Runs on its own
note: Intentional off is calm and must stay legible; not a broken thing.

wordFamily: Queued · Running · Waiting · Paused · Done · Failed · Stopped · Skipped · Needs you
note: The Needs you run label outside Inbox is flagged; legacy detail is retained here as evidence. A run’s Failed does not add a thread flag.

wordFamily: not yet · running · waiting · done · failed · skipped · stopped · blocked · uncertain
note: uncertain is not “nothing happened”; never suggest a blind repeat of a non-idempotent action.

wordFamily: Last run … · Next run … · No runs yet · Run #N is waiting for a yes.
note: A timestamp and a link help find the run; do not infer Overview freshness from it.

wordFamily: RUN · LIVE · RUN · DONE · {run attention}
note: A live/attention flag may contribute working/waiting; label text alone cannot.

wordFamily: Now · To do · Done · Waiting for you (plan step)
note: A plan step’s state does not replace the parent thread flags.

wordFamily: Turn failed · Tried again at … · Deploy … failed · Deployed …
note: Keep outcome visible with a useful way forward; no failed thread flag.

wordFamily: Assessing · Assessment failed · Assessment blocked · Assessment paused · Resolved
note: Report/assessment state, not thing health or a person decision by wording alone.

wordFamily: No longer needed. · Here’s what I’ll do … · Here’s what I did …
note: Use research/plan state and actual steps. Historic done words do not settle a thread.

wordFamily: Quiet · Plenty free · Normal · {figure verdict}
note: A resource observation, not a second health scale and not an assurance of fresh data.

wordFamily: Checked {time} · Used today · up {duration} · 24 h avg
note: Only Checked is about a check; use/uptime/range never prove the sample time.

wordFamily: Not signed in · Sign in again · Connecting · Waiting for you to finish signing in…
note: Derive the thing level from status separately. A sign-in step can wait on the person.

wordFamily: Loading… · Checking… · Couldn’t read … · Not checked yet
note: A lack of evidence must stay distinct from Connected and from “not working”.
